task.title: Card detail view printings list updates
task.description:
In a card detail view, for the table listing all of the card printings:
 - Hovering a row should show the small popup for that printing's art, same as in a catalog list view
 - Some cards have a lot of printings, which makes this table very long. Cap the element to a height of approx 20 items and make it scrollable
 - Clicking on a row should navigate you to that specific printing card ID in the catalog (same view, but correct art now and the specific printing at the top of the list)
